title: Recession-proof Dividend King offers safe 2.2% yield
title_zh: 防衰退股息王提供2.2%的安全收益率
summary: Johnson & Johnson reported impressive fourth-quarter results that beat expectations while outlining an aggressive growth strategy.
summary_zh: 强生公司公布了令人印象深刻的第四季度业绩，超出了预期，同时概述了积极的增长战略。

title: IREN’s AI Pivot Deepens With Microsoft Deal And GPU Build-Out
title_zh: IREN 的 AI 支点随着微软交易和 GPU 扩建而深化
summary: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) has secured $3.6b in GPU financing supported by leading global banks. The company aligned this funding with a $1.9b customer prepayment tied to a $9.7b AI contract with Microsoft.
summary_zh: IREN（纳斯达克GS：IREN）已获得由全球领先银行支持的 3.6 亿美元 GPU 融资。该公司将这笔资金与 19 亿美元的客户预付款结合起来，该预付款与与微软签订的 9.7 亿美元的人工智能合同相关。

title: How Likely Is a Stock Market Crash Under President Donald Trump? Several Century-Old Data Sets Offer an Answer.
title_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的股市崩盘的可能性有多大？几个具有百年历史的数据集提供了答案。
summary: Headwinds are mounting for a historically expensive stock market during Trump's second, non-consecutive term.
summary_zh: 在特朗普的第二个非连续任期内，历史上昂贵的股市面临的阻力越来越大。

title: Salesforce Lands Major Army AI Deal As Valuation Discount Persists
title_zh: 由于估值折扣持续存在，Salesforce 获得了陆军人工智能重大交易
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has been awarded a 10 year, US$5.6b contract with the U.S. Army to deliver secure data and AI technologies. The deal is described as one of the largest government cloud and AI agreements to date, focused on federal digital modernization.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）已与美国陆军签订了一份为期 10 年、价值 5.6 亿美元的合同，以提供安全数据和人工智能技术。该交易被描述为迄今为止最大的政府云和人工智能协议之一，重点关注联邦数字现代化。

title: Software Stocks Sell-Off: Are They Deals or Traps?
title_zh: 软件股抛售：是交易还是陷阱？
summary: Possible negative AI impacts are spooking technology investors but is the selling overdone?
summary_zh: 人工智能可能带来的负面影响令科技投资者感到不安，但抛售是否过度了？
